Class Decks

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Decks
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Decks extends Object implements Serializable
Holds the game's draw decks, keeping cards and buildings separated and partitioned by Age. Cards and buildings are routed into the correct collection through the Visitor pattern (Card.addToDeck(Decks)).

  • Constructor Details

    • Decks

      public Decks()
      Default constructor for Jackson deserialization.

    • Decks

      public Decks(List<Card> cards, List<Building> buildings)
      Builds the decks from flat lists of cards and buildings, partitioning each element by age. Every element is dispatched through Card.addToDeck(Decks) (Visitor pattern) so it is routed to the correct per-age collection.
      Parameters:
      cards - the cards to distribute across the age decks
      buildings - the buildings to distribute across the age decks

    • popCard

      public Optional<Card> popCard(Age a)
      Removes and returns the top card of the deck for the given age. If the age's deck is empty, falls back to the overflow deck of the next age when it shares the same numeric value.
      Parameters:
      a - the age whose deck to draw from
      Returns:
      the drawn card, or empty if no card is available
